Title: Declared PDSCH/DL-SCH parameter matrix is only partially executable
CurrentEvidence: +sixgr/+pdsch contains several metadata-only stages; existing tests cover selected tuples rather than the declared Cartesian/pairwise matrix.
RequiredImplementation: Promote +sixgr/+pdsch to the canonical explicit TX/RX chain and execute rank, codeword, modulation, DM-RS, PTRS, RV, reservation, precoding and channel combinations through production code.
MandatoryAcceptance: All supplied coverage rows plus deterministic pairwise matrix; no-noise exact rank 1-8; bounded AWGN/TDL/CDL campaigns.

Title: Frequency-selective PRG precoding is rejected or collapsed to wideband
CurrentEvidence: +sixgr/+phy/+dl/resolvePDSCHPrecoding.m raises PRGBundleUnsupported for 3-D bundles and accepts only a 2-D wideband matrix.
RequiredImplementation: Implement W[Ntx,Nlayers,NPRG,NSymbolGroups], exact PRG/symbol maps, application to data/DMRS/PTRS and receiver effective-channel use.
MandatoryAcceptance: All 15 supplied precoding cases; independent matrix multiplication; slice digests; TX/RX application counts; power conservation.

Title: DM-RS ports are overwritten and valid custom ports are rejected
CurrentEvidence: allocREsPDSCH.m assigns DMRSPortSet=0:(NumLayers-1); resolvePDSCHPrecoding.m rejects custom port sets.
RequiredImplementation: Resolve ports from decoded antenna-port field and RRC DMRS context, preserve non-consecutive valid ports, separate logical DM-RS ports from physical antennas.
MandatoryAcceptance: 108 supplied port-table rows; no mutation; exact port/CDM/delta/index/sequence checks.

Title: DM-RS mapping combinations are clamped or incomplete
CurrentEvidence: Type-A position, configuration type, additional position, length and CDM groups are min/max clamped; invalid type-A mapping may be changed to type B.
RequiredImplementation: Table-driven mapping A/B, type 1/2, length 1/2, additional positions, basic/enhanced multiplexing and exact sequence/index generation.
MandatoryAcceptance: 175 supplied symbol-position rows, 108 port rows, independent DM-RS sequence vectors, typed negative errors before waveform generation.

Title: Scalar PMI/configured matrix does not implement complete precoding procedure
CurrentEvidence: An explicit matrix may be discarded and regenerated from scalar PMI; scalar PMI can be reported without proving the matrix applied per frequency region.
RequiredImplementation: Consume an immutable resolved matrix bundle; validate PMI/matrix epoch; never treat PMI as the applied matrix. Codebook selection remains an upstream MIMO responsibility.
MandatoryAcceptance: Matrix-resolution and matrix-application digests equal for every PRG/symbol group; stale PMI/matrix negative tests.

Title: Reserved-resource/rate-matching behavior and exact G are incomplete
CurrentEvidence: CSI-RS collision is handled after PDSCH generation; computeResourceAccounting floors inferred NRE/PRB and reconstructs G when exact evidence is absent.
RequiredImplementation: Build one pre-coding ownership map for SSB, CORESET, rateMatchPattern, ZP/NZP CSI-RS, LTE CRS, DMRS, PTRS and data; derive TBS/G/E from exact final indices.
MandatoryAcceptance: 14 supplied union cases; zero collisions; exact data/reserved index sets; TBS and G respond correctly to reservations.

Title: PT-RS configuration and receiver effect are partial
CurrentEvidence: Time/frequency density, RE offset and port are defaulted or rounded; current evidence can stop at RE presence.
RequiredImplementation: Resolve standard presence/density/port conditions, generate exact sequence/indices, estimate CPE and correct data at the receiver.
MandatoryAcceptance: 56 supplied cases; independent index checks; multi-severity phase-noise test with pre/post CPE and EVM.

Title: Dynamic connected PDSCH grants are constructed from configuration; downlink SPS activation ownership is absent
CurrentEvidence: resolveWaveformGrant creates explicit_waveform_grant and defaults full grid/full slot; PDSCH_Tx accepts config/frozen grant; PDCCH binding is policy-optional.
RequiredImplementation: Create immutable PDSCHSchedulingAssignment from decoded DCI plus current UE/RRC/BWP/HARQ/TCI context for dynamic scheduling; add a separate SPS occasion factory requiring RRC SPS configuration plus a prior CRC-valid activation DCI; isolate direct calibration assignments.
MandatoryAcceptance: 22 supplied assignment cases including dynamic, activated SPS, released/not-activated SPS, and calibration isolation; assignment/activation event ID preserved TX-to-RX; every invalid case generates no waveform.

Title: Normative 1024QAM support and unsupported modulation handling are incomplete
CurrentEvidence: Current path depends on Toolbox-supported modulation and defaults missing modulation to QPSK; earlier audit wording treated all 1024QAM as research-only.
RequiredImplementation: Implement exact Release-18 1024QAM mapper/demapper and enabling conditions; reject reserved MCS and 4096QAM; remove QPSK/list fallback.
MandatoryAcceptance: Independent QPSK-1024QAM vectors, full constellation normalization, 1024QAM no-noise and BLER cases, negative 4096QAM.

Title: BWP, cross-carrier, TCI/QCL and multi-TRP PDSCH state is incomplete
CurrentEvidence: PDSCH state is mainly scalar/single-context and connected assignment does not fully bind active BWP, carrier, TCI/QCL and multiple transmission occasions.
RequiredImplementation: Bind assignment to active BWP/CC/config epoch, cross-carrier indicator and activated TCI; represent and execute bounded multi-TRP transmission occasions.
MandatoryAcceptance: Active/stale BWP, cross-carrier, TCI/QCL and two-TRP positive/negative end-to-end tests.

Title: Rank 5-8 and two-codeword paths exist but are not broadly proven end to end
CurrentEvidence: PDSCH_Tx contains rank 1-8 guards and 5:[2,3],6:[3,3],7:[3,4],8:[4,4] splits, but broad DMRS/PTRS/precoding/channel/HARQ coverage is absent.
RequiredImplementation: Keep the correct split, execute actual symbol mapping/demapping, per-codeword coding/MCS/RV/G and high-rank receiver/precoder paths.
MandatoryAcceptance: Independent rank 1-8 mapping; no-noise exact TB recovery for every rank; two-codeword HARQ and selected AWGN/TDL/CDL cases.

Title: Same MATLAB Toolbox implementation is used as both DUT and reference
CurrentEvidence: Existing tests compare nrPDSCH/nrPDSCHPrecode/nrTBS/nrDLSCH-derived production output with the same primitives.
RequiredImplementation: Retain Toolbox regressions but add pure-spec/frozen-independent oracles for all mandatory bit/index/coding/precoding/receiver families.
MandatoryAcceptance: pdsch_independent_vector_results.csv contains all 16 mandatory families with zero mismatches and independent source/version/hash.
